key: WITH usgs_peaks AS (SELECT to_date(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(hr_utc, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago')) AS local_day, hr_utc AS usgs_peak_hr_utc, usgs_northport_peak_cfs AS usgs_peak_cfs FROM water.hourly_compare WHERE hr_utc BETWEEN '2026-10-23 00:00' AND '2026-10-25 06:00' AND usgs_northport_peak_cfs IS NOT NULL QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY to_date(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(hr_utc, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago')) ORDER BY usgs_northport_peak_cfs DESC) = 1)
